package filestorage

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/aes"
	"crypto/cipher"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime/multipart"
	"net/http"
	"net/textproto"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const maxPublicationArchiveBytes = 20 << 20

var publicationCipherHeader = []byte("MSSTUDENTPUB\x01")

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	EncryptionKey []byte
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func NewClient(baseURL, internalToken, encodedEncryptionKey string) (Client, error) {
	client := Client{BaseURL: baseURL, InternalToken: internalToken}
	encodedEncryptionKey = strings.TrimSpace(encodedEncryptionKey)
	if encodedEncryptionKey == "" {
		return client, nil
	}
	key, err := decodeEncryptionKey(encodedEncryptionKey)
	if err != nil {
		return Client{}, err
	}
	client.EncryptionKey = key
	return client, nil
}

func (client Client) DownloadSourceArchive(ctx context.Context, fileID string) ([]byte, error) {
	return client.download(ctx, fileID, maxPublicationArchiveBytes)
}

func (client Client) DownloadPublicationSnapshot(ctx context.Context, fileID string) ([]byte, error) {
	content, err := client.download(ctx, fileID, maxPublicationArchiveBytes+(1<<20))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return client.decryptPublicationSnapshot(content)
}

func (client Client) download(ctx context.Context, fileID string, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(
		ctx,
		http.MethodGet,
		fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/v1/files/%s/download", strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/"), fileID),
		nil,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("filestorage download failed: %s", response.Status)
	}
	content, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maxBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if int64(len(content)) > maxBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("filestorage download exceeds size limit")
	}
	return content, nil
}

func (client Client) UploadTemporaryArchive(
	ctx context.Context,
	ownerID, filename string,
	content []byte,
) (string, error) {
	if len(content) == 0 || len(content) > maxPublicationArchiveBytes {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("publication archive must be between 1 byte and %d bytes", maxPublicationArchiveBytes)
	}
	protectedContent, err := client.encryptPublicationSnapshot(content)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	body := bytes.NewBuffer(nil)
	writer := multipart.NewWriter(body)
	header := make(textproto.MIMEHeader)
	header.Set("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf(`form-data; name="file"; filename="%s"`, strings.ReplaceAll(filename, `"`, "")))
	header.Set("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
	filePart, err := writer.CreatePart(header)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if _, err := filePart.Write(protectedContent); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	for key, value := range map[string]string{
		"file_kind":      "STUDENT_SUBMISSION",
		"owner_id":       ownerID,
		"is_archive":     "false",
		"archive_format": "",
		"is_temp":        "true",
		"ttl_minutes":    "60",
	} {
		if err := writer.WriteField(key, value); err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
	}
	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(
		ctx,
		http.MethodPost,
		strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/v1/files/upload",
		body,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", writer.FormDataContentType())
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusCreated {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("filestorage upload failed: %s", response.Status)
	}
	var payload struct {
		ID string `json:"ID"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 1<<20)).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(payload.ID) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("filestorage upload response is missing ID")
	}
	return payload.ID, nil
}

func (client Client) encryptPublicationSnapshot(plaintext []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	aead, err := client.publicationAEAD()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	nonce := make([]byte, aead.NonceSize())
	if _, err := rand.Read(nonce); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("generate publication encryption nonce: %w", err)
	}
	result := make([]byte, 0, len(publicationCipherHeader)+len(nonce)+len(plaintext)+aead.Overhead())
	result = append(result, publicationCipherHeader...)
	result = append(result, nonce...)
	result = aead.Seal(result, nonce, plaintext, publicationCipherHeader)
	return result, nil
}

func (client Client) decryptPublicationSnapshot(ciphertext []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	aead, err := client.publicationAEAD()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	prefixBytes := len(publicationCipherHeader) + aead.NonceSize()
	if len(ciphertext) < prefixBytes+aead.Overhead() || !bytes.Equal(ciphertext[:len(publicationCipherHeader)], publicationCipherHeader) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("publication snapshot has an invalid encryption envelope")
	}
	nonce := ciphertext[len(publicationCipherHeader):prefixBytes]
	plaintext, err := aead.Open(nil, nonce, ciphertext[prefixBytes:], publicationCipherHeader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decrypt publication snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	if len(plaintext) == 0 || len(plaintext) > maxPublicationArchiveBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decrypted publication snapshot exceeds size limit")
	}
	return plaintext, nil
}

func (client Client) publicationAEAD() (cipher.AEAD, error) {
	if len(client.EncryptionKey) != 32 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("practice task publication encryption is not configured")
	}
	block, err := aes.NewCipher(client.EncryptionKey)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return cipher.NewGCM(block)
}

func decodeEncryptionKey(value string) ([]byte, error) {
	encodings := []*base64.Encoding{
		base64.StdEncoding, base64.RawStdEncoding, base64.URLEncoding, base64.RawURLEncoding,
	}
	for _, encoding := range encodings {
		decoded, err := encoding.DecodeString(value)
		if err == nil && len(decoded) == 32 {
			return decoded, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("PRACTICE_TASK_PUBLICATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY must be a base64-encoded 32-byte key")
}

func (client Client) Activate(ctx context.Context, fileID string) error {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(
		ctx,
		http.MethodPost,
		fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/v1/files/%s/activate", strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/"), fileID),
		nil,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return fmt.Errorf("filestorage activation failed: %s", response.Status)
	}
	return nil
}
func (client Client) authorize(request *http.Request) {
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
}

func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
}
